gates.description: From a clean checkout/disposable environment, follow the written setup and Compose instructions. Reach first-owner setup without undeclared manual fixes.
gates.required_evidence: E2 + E4-local; setup log and environment record.

gates.description: Repeat setup/start. Existing generated secrets, owner, database records, and media remain intact; no silent reseed or reset.
Inspect and exercise network binding. Only the web surface is host-published on loopback; database and worker are not publicly bound.
With provider credentials absent and external runtime requests denied/monitored, complete the manual workflow. Dependency/image pulls are outside this runtime observation window.
gates.required_evidence: E2; network assertions/log summary and export.

gates.description: Stop the worker. The editor/save/local media remain usable; status becomes degraded and a requested render honestly waits. Restart restores readiness.
Stop and recreate the app/worker/database containers without deleting volumes. Login, projects, revision IDs, accepted media hashes, and ready exports remain valid.
Missing/invalid setup token cannot create an owner. Two simultaneous valid setup attempts create exactly one owner/workspace; reused bootstrap is closed.
Correct login works; wrong credentials fail; basic rate limiting operates; logout and finite expiry invalidate protected access.
Inspect cookie flags and execute cross-origin state-changing attempts, including multipart upload. Unsafe host/origin/CSRF requests fail. The loopback HTTP exception is explicit.
Unauthenticated requests cannot read/mutate projects, drafts, assets, thumbnails, render details, final images, exports, or owner-only status.
Controlled second-workspace fixtures cannot access another workspace's resources by guessing IDs or supplying foreign asset references.
gates.required_evidence: E2; command and HTTP authorization checks.

gates.description: Passwords/setup tokens/session secrets are absent from ordinary logs, URLs, committed config, browser bundles, output manifests, screenshots, and export files. Auth bypass/signup shortcuts are absent.
Create, list, rename, reopen, and switch between two projects with independent persisted drafts.
Save a valid document, inspect its immutable revision/hash, save an edit, and prove the earlier revision was not mutated.
Reject unsupported schema versions/layout/font IDs, bad slide/block IDs, duplicate IDs, illegal counts/boxes, foreign assets, arbitrary URLs, and invalid numeric values.
Semantically identical documents with different object-key insertion order hash consistently under the declared canonicalizer; array order/content changes alter the hash.
Autosave reports unsaved/saving/saved correctly, flush-before-preview waits for acknowledgment, and browser close/reopen retrieves the saved deck.
gates.required_evidence: E2; browser test with controlled responses.

gates.description: Two tabs edit the same base revision. The second stale save is rejected; its local buffer survives; explicit safe reload does not silently discard unacknowledged work.
Delay/drop/reorder save responses and temporarily fail a save. A late response cannot clobber newer text or show false saved state; retry/reconciliation does not overwrite a later revision.
gates.required_evidence: E2; network fault tests and head assertions.

gates.description: Title, caption, hashtags, slide content and order are bound to one saved revision. Concurrent later editing cannot change a render/export already requested for that revision.
Upload valid JPEG, PNG, and static WebP in a batch. Each has a durable accepted record, image dimensions/hash, thumbnail, and selectable local asset.
Mix valid and invalid files in a batch. Per-file errors are useful; accepted files remain available and are not rolled back unnecessarily.
Reject disguised HTML/SVG, corrupt/truncated data, animation, unsupported formats, and mismatched content. Do not trust extension/MIME alone.
Enforce byte, decoded-pixel, edge, frame, batch, and execution limits. Oversized inputs cannot bypass streaming limits by lying about content length.
EXIF orientation displays/exports correctly. Transparent-image handling is intentional. Public/render/export derivatives omit private EXIF/GPS metadata.
Traversal-like and header-injection filenames cannot escape storage or alter download headers. Media is not anonymously exposed through static paths.
Retain source/upload time/user assertion and original/derivative hashes. Identical bytes do not erase distinct source records; no cross-workspace deduplication leak.

Inject decode/storage/DB commit failure. No accepted asset points to missing bytes; failed staging is safely tracked/cleaned. Missing/corrupt referenced media later blocks render without deleting the draft.
gates.required_evidence: E2; failure boundaries and hash checks.

gates.description: Add, duplicate, remove, and reorder slides using non-drag controls. IDs remain stable on reorder and are fresh on duplication. Minimum/maximum slide bounds are enforced.
All three layouts work, can be mixed, and preserve text through switching. Hiding/replacing an image does not delete its accepted local original.
Changing 9:16/4:5 updates every slide's trusted geometry and resulting dimensions without stretching the source or losing text.
Every exposed text/font/weight/size/line-height/alignment/color/panel/placement control changes stored data and final rendering as intended. No decorative controls.
Cover/contain, focal reposition, reset, and replacement are nondestructive and match final output. Use off-center and landscape fixtures.
At least 50 logical session edits support sensible undo/redo. New edits clear redo; text editing does not double-apply app/browser keyboard undo.
gates.required_evidence: E2; grouped edit and shortcut tests.

gates.description: Long text/newlines/unbroken tokens produce measured wrapping or an explicit overflow error. No silent clipping or minimum-font-size violation.
Empty/loading/error/saved/conflict states are understandable; main actions have labels/focus and keyboard access. Desktop and narrow layouts do not hide essential actions.
A render request references an exact immutable saved revision. A queued job renders that snapshot even after the live draft changes.
Application intent and pg-boss enqueue share a tested transaction, or an exercised outbox/reconciliation mechanism prevents lost work. Simulated handoff failure cannot lose acknowledged intent.
Replay the same render command with the same client request ID/payload: one logical request. Same key/different payload: conflict.
Render all layouts at both canvas presets using the pinned browser and local assets. Output JPEG dimensions/count/decode validity match the document.
Delay required fonts/images. Capture waits for actual font faces/image decode. Missing resources fail with actionable diagnostics; no silent fallback success.
Editor and worker use the shared trusted scene/layout implementation. Overflow, missing media, and unsupported glyph conditions prevent a ready artifact.
gates.required_evidence: E1 + E2; architecture inspection and validation failures.

gates.description: User script-like strings render as text. Rejected URLs/CSS/HTML cannot execute, read local files, or make outbound requests.
gates.required_evidence: E2; containment tests with network/file sentinels.

gates.description: Shipped renderer runs non-root with verified sandbox configuration and a minimal browser subprocess environment. No auth cookies, DB secrets, privileged container, broad host mounts, or Docker socket access.
gates.required_evidence: E1 + E2; launch/config assertions and canary tests.

gates.description: Render execution timeout terminates the affected attempt, leaves an honest failure/retry state, and does not hang the entire worker indefinitely.
Kill/restart a worker during a render. The accepted request becomes recoverable, retains revision identity, respects attempt limits, and eventually succeeds or explicitly fails.
gates.required_evidence: E4-local; process lifecycle log and DB checks.

gates.description: Duplicate/reclaimed job deliveries cannot finalize competing outputs for one request. A stale attempt cannot overwrite the accepted newer success.
Crash after writing some/all staged files but before DB ready commit. Recovery does not expose partial success, delete accepted media, or strand the request forever.
Invalid/overflow/missing-font failures do not automatically retry; eligible transient failures stop at the documented maximum of three total attempts. No infinite loop.
Repeat a fixed fixture in the same pinned render environment; compare outputs and record the visual tolerance/results. Inspect geometry/crop/text differences instead of blindly updating goldens.
Final preview requests the exact immutable final JPEGs, not editor screenshots, optimized/re-encoded alternatives, or raw provider/source images.
Extract the ZIP and SHA-256 its images. Each equals both the manifest's hash and the final-preview response body for that slide.
Seven-slide export has exactly `01.jpg`–`07.jpg`, `post.txt`, and `manifest.json` in the agreed structure. Ordered slide IDs and visible content match the draft revision.
gates.required_evidence: E2 + visual; ZIP structure and sequence assertions.

gates.description: `post.txt` exactly matches the reviewed revision's title/caption/hashtags, including Unicode; manifest covers its hash/editorial identity.
Editing after render visibly invalidates current-preview/export readiness. A queued or historical render never silently becomes the new draft's current export.
No originals/private metadata/secrets/raw rights files/absolute paths leak into the ZIP. Entries/download filename cannot contain unsafe paths or injected headers.
Repeated download reuses ready JPEGs and does not launch a new render. A packaging/storage failure produces a useful error, not a corrupt success download.
Anonymous/foreign access cannot read final images or ZIPs even with a known artifact ID. A logged-in owner can still download a ready artifact while the worker is stopped.
Execute the complete original seven-slide journey through the UI, including edits, one duplicate/reorder operation, final preview, and export, with no provider credential.
gates.required_evidence: E2; full browser test and representative ZIP.

gates.description: Inspect real app screenshots and final output for readable typography, correct crop/composition, sensible spacing, and helpful error states. Include both canvas presets.
Test at a normal desktop viewport and a narrow viewport; record sizes. Main journey is keyboard-operable; no critical automated accessibility violations remain on those tested screens.
Lint, strict types, deployable build, and all established required test commands run with actual results. A zero-test/discovery failure cannot be reported as success.
Initial migrations run on an empty database and are safe on a second invocation. Web/worker do not race uncontrolled schema changes.
Simulate storage unavailable/permission failure or bounded low-space behavior. Saving/rendering failures are visible; existing accepted content is not silently deleted or corrupted.
gates.required_evidence: E2; failure injection and UI/state evidence.

gates.description: Secrets/canaries are absent from client bundles, normal logs, generated artifacts, Git diff, and browser-renderer environment. Runtime third-party telemetry/CDN requests are absent in the measured manual journey.
A new reader can follow README installation/operation/troubleshooting. Document persistent volumes, stopping vs deleting data, running tests, limitations, and worker/host availability.
gates.required_evidence: E1 + clean-run evidence; do not claim an independent human test unless one occurred.

gates.description: UI wording/layouts/demo assets are original or properly attributed. Runtime/dependency/font sources/licenses are recorded; existing license is preserved and pending decisions are not silently finalized.
No unscoped providers, key forms, direct TikTok integration, fake connections/analytics, billing, scheduling, MP4, or marketplace functionality slipped into the patch.
Root state points to the real spec hash, active chapter, base/tested commit, handoff, and evidence. Parent requirement subsets remain partial/unreviewed as appropriate.
Handoff lists all mandatory gates with PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN, actual implementation/evidence commits, skipped checks, deficiencies, and real artifact locations.
All public/committed screenshots, traces, logs, and exports use synthetic/local demo data and are sanitized. Artifact hashes correspond to files that actually exist.
No work on the next chapter, public release/tag/deployment, paid API request, account authorization, or public post occurs. Final implementation status is awaiting review, never self-accepted.
